title: 📝 Posts — {title}
intro: Every post and every edit is kept as a version. With approval on, posts made in the channel are held until the owner or a Full admin approves them; posts written through Aegis can be published now, later, or sent for approval.
need_rights: ⚠️ Aegis needs «Post», «Edit» and «Delete messages» in the channel.
compose_prompt: Send the post for {title}: text, photo, video, GIF, file, music, voice, video message or sticker (one message, no albums).
compose_bad: This can't be published through Aegis: send one text, photo, video, GIF, file, music, voice, video message or sticker.
draft_full: You can publish it now or at a time.
draft_approval: It will go to the owner and Full admins for approval.
time_prompt: Send the time as «21:30» (the next one) or «2026-11-02 08:00». Time zone: {tz}.
time_bad: Use «21:30» or «2026-11-02 08:00» ({tz}), at most 30 days ahead.
sent_approval_none: 📨 Waiting for approval (no approver can be reached privately — they'll see it in the panel).
queue_full: The queue is full (at most {max} posts).
gone: This post is no longer here.
restore_q: Put the post back to version {n}?
cant_restore: This kind of post can't be edited by a bot.
crisis_on: 🆘 Crisis mode is ON — started {ago} ago by {by}.
crisis_report: Links revoked: {links} · admins demoted: {admins} · discussion group locked: {group}
crisis_links_q: Revoke all links made through Aegis and make a new primary link?
crisis_admins_q: Demote every admin appointed through Aegis (not you, not the owner)? Appoint them again later under «Admins».
crisis_end_q: End crisis mode and put things back?
crisis_alert: 🆘 Crisis mode was started by {by}: {links} links revoked, {admins} admins demoted.
cant_demote: This needs «Add new admins» for you and Aegis.
backup_intro: Export the channel's Aegis settings and lists as a file and restore them (here or in another channel). A backup chat gets a copy of every new post, and older posts can be copied there in batches.
restore_prompt: Send the backup file (.json) exported by Aegis.
restore_summary: In the file: {settings} settings, {entries} list entries, {locks} lock and security settings.
restore_other: ⚠️ The backup is from another chat.
restore_err_not_backup: That isn't an Aegis backup file.
restore_err_version: This backup is from another version of Aegis.
restore_err_type: A channel's backup can only go to a channel (and a group's to a group).
restore_err_empty: There's nothing to restore in this file.
mirror_prompt: Choose the backup channel or group with the buttons below (Aegis must be able to post there, and you must be an admin there), forward a post from it, or send @username or the -100… id.
mirror_connected: 📦 This chat now keeps a copy of the posts of {title}.
job_q: Copy posts 1 … {last} into the backup chat, a batch a minute (or press «Next batch»)? Telegram limits how fast a bot may post.
job_no_last: Aegis hasn't seen a post of this channel yet: publish one (or wait for the next), then start the copy.
step_wait: ⏳ Telegram asks to wait a little; the next batch comes later.
